context.executive_summary: Apex Financial Services is poised to redefine its digital presence. We propose a comprehensive migration of your legacy web portal into a high-performance, secure mobile application. This initiative will not only modernize your customer interface but also ensure compliance with evolving financial regulations, ultimately driving a projected 40% increase in user engagement.
context.why_us: Our agency specializes in high-stakes Fintech modernization. Unlike generalist firms, we have a dedicated Compliance Engineering team that understands SOC2 and PCI-DSS requirements. We don't just build apps; we build secure financial ecosystems.
context.proposed_solution: We will implement a 'Mobile-First' strategy using a microservices backend. The core transaction engine will be decoupled from the user interface, allowing for faster updates and independent scaling. The mobile app will utilize biometric authentication (FaceID/TouchID) to replace legacy password systems.
scope_of_work: Phase 1: Comprehensive audit of existing SQL databases and API endpoints.
Phase 2: UI/UX redesign focusing on accessibility and speed.
Phase 3: Development of iOS and Android applications using a single codebase.
Phase 4: Migration of 50,000+ user accounts to the new cloud database.
Phase 5: Implementation of real-time fraud detection algorithms.

risk_management.mitigation: Parallel run of legacy and new systems for 2 weeks.
Implementation of circuit-breaker patterns and caching.
Strict change request process governed by the SOW.

quality_assurance: Integration Testing for all 3rd party APIs
Load Testing to support 10k concurrent users

case_study.title: Scaling NeoBank to 1M Users
case_study.challenge: Legacy on-premise servers were crashing during payday traffic spikes.
case_study.outcome: We migrated them to AWS Serverless, resulting in 99.99% uptime and a 40% reduction in operational costs.

context.next_steps: To initiate this partnership, we recommend a Technical Discovery Workshop scheduled for next Tuesday. Please review the attached Statement of Work (SOW) and return a signed copy by February 28th to lock in the proposed timeline.
